NEXT EXECUTION BLOCK — RESTORE ACCESS, RECONCILE CODE, AND DEPLOY SAFELY

Stop returning status-only reports.

The environment variables were already configured. Now verify whether they are actually available inside the execution environment and continue the work.

Canonical repository:

GitHub owner: ibb142
Repository: ivx-holdings-platform

Known live production SHA:

012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c

Known local SHA:

6b69a111f568434b080cc0a0ec005aaa772c7045

1. VERIFY RUNTIME CREDENTIAL INJECTION

Check whether the following are available to the active execution environment:

- GitHub authentication credential or GitHub App access
- Render API key
- Render service ID
- Supabase production configuration
- Owner-authenticated session capability

Do not print or expose any secret values.

For each required credential, return only:

- variable or integration name
- present or absent
- usable or unusable
- validation result
- exact error code if unusable

If the variables exist in Render but are not available in this execution environment, identify the exact environment where they must be configured.

2. RESTORE CANONICAL GITHUB ACCESS

Using the approved GitHub authentication method:

- Verify access to ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
- Read repository metadata
- Read default branch
- Read GitHub HEAD SHA
- Read recent commits
- Read pull requests
- Read GitHub Actions runs

Do not request that I paste tokens into chat.

If access still returns 401 or 404, provide the exact permission or installation setting that must be corrected.

3. CREATE RECOVERY PROTECTION

Before changing any code:

- Create a backup branch from the current local SHA
- Create a recovery tag
- Preserve uncommitted files
- Preserve untracked files
- Preserve stashes
- Create a git bundle or patch backup

Do not reset, delete, overwrite, or force-push any code.

4. COMPARE SOURCE STATES

Compare:

A. Canonical GitHub HEAD
B. Live production SHA
C. Local checkout SHA

Provide:

- commits only in local
- commits only in GitHub
- commits included in production
- changed files
- conflicting files
- untracked files
- approved changes not live
- obsolete or duplicate changes

5. ESTABLISH SOURCE OF TRUTH

The canonical GitHub repository must become the official source of truth.

Do not deploy the local checkout directly.

Create a clean reconciliation branch from the correct canonical base and apply only approved IVX changes.

Preserve all working production features.

6. RUN COMPLETE VALIDATION

Run:

- backend typecheck
- Expo typecheck
- lint
- unit tests
- integration tests
- registration tests
- authentication tests
- authorization tests
- OTP security tests
- production build
- Android tests
- web end-to-end tests

Fix all critical failures before merge.

7. PUSH, PR, CI, AND MERGE

- Push the reconciliation branch
- Open or update the pull request
- Run GitHub Actions on the exact candidate SHA
- Fix all required failures
- Merge only when required checks are green
- Record the final merged SHA

8. DEPLOY THE EXACT FINAL SHA

- Confirm Render is connected to ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
- Confirm the correct production branch
- Deploy the final merged SHA
- Record Render deployment ID
- Verify /health returns HTTP 200
- Verify /version returns the final SHA
- Restart Render
- Verify /health and /version again

Required equality:

GitHub HEAD SHA
=
GitHub Actions SHA
=
Render deployed SHA
=
Live /version SHA

9. COMPLETE LIVE QA

Verify in production:

- new member registration
- email verification
- phone verification
- member sign-in
- logout and repeat sign-in
- password reset
- member denied owner routes
- owner sign-in
- Owner Dashboard
- Members module
- Admin Hub
- session persistence
- primary AI provider without fallback
- Android
- iOS
- web

10. FINAL RESPONSE

Return only:

- credential availability summary
- GitHub access result
- backup branch
- recovery tag
- GitHub HEAD before reconciliation
- local SHA before reconciliation
- live SHA before deployment
- final merged SHA
- CI result
- Render deployment ID
- live /version SHA
- SHA parity result
- member registration result
- member sign-in result
- owner sign-in result
- primary AI result
- remaining blockers

Do not claim completion without exact evidence.
